betrieb.die-adresse-darf-keine: The address must not contain parameters (?…) or anchors (#…).
betrieb.der-port-muss-zwischen: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
betrieb.der-server-ist-kein: The server isn’t a valid host name, e.g. smtp.example.org.
betrieb.der-absender-ist-keine: The sender isn’t a valid email address, e.g. dms@example.org or “Ablago <dms@example.org>”.
betrieb.passwoerter-lassen-sich-erst: Passwords can only be saved once there is a key (Workbench → Encryption).
betrieb.liegt-noch-unverschluesselt-und: is still unencrypted and will be encrypted as soon as there is a key
betrieb.bitte-in-der-werkbank: please enter again in the Workbench under “Email and address”
betrieb.bitte-eine-gueltige-e: Please enter a valid email address for the test email.
betrieb.hallo-diese-testmail-kommt:
Hello,

this test email comes from the Workbench of your Ablago. Email sending via {host} works.
betrieb.testmail-an-verschickt-sie: Test email sent to {ziel}. It should arrive within a few minutes (also check the spam folder).
designs.der-schriftzug-darf-hoechstens: The lettering may have at most {SCHRIFTZUG_MAX} characters.
designs.grundlage-automatisch-hell-dunke: Basis: automatic, light, dark or contrast.
designs.das-eigene-css-ist: The custom CSS is too long (at most 50,000 characters).
designs.das-css-darf-kein: The CSS must not contain “<” (in texts write \3C instead).
designs.das-svg-enthaelt-skripte: The SVG contains scripts, events or references to other files. Please use a plain SVG or PNG.
designs.das-logo-bitte-als: Please provide the logo as PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG.
designs.das-logo-darf-hoechstens: The logo may be at most 1 MB.
designs.das-standard-design-kann: The default theme can’t be deleted. First make another one the default.
hilfe.diese-seite-gibt-es: This page doesn’t exist in the help.
region.unbekannte-zeitzone-bitte-eine: Unknown time zone – please choose one from the list, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
sprachen.unbekannt: This language doesn’t exist in Ablago.
sprachen.standard-erlaubt: The installation’s language must be allowed.
sprachen.nicht-eingerichtet: The languages can’t be set here.
uebersetzung.quelle-unbekannt: What should be translated is missing or unknown (field of a folder, note or full text of a document).
uebersetzung.kein-paket: “{paket}” is not an installed package with the permission “Translate content”.
uebersetzung.abfluss-bestaetigen: “{name}” sends the texts to {ziele} for translation. Please confirm this explicitly.
uebersetzung.feld-nicht: This field can’t be translated (only text without a format, long text and formatted text).
uebersetzung.nur-personen: Translation is only available to people, not to packages.
uebersetzung.selbst-aus: You have switched off “Show translation” in My account.
uebersetzung.kein-angebot: Translation isn’t available right now: it is switched off, or no package for it is running.
uebersetzung.leer: There is no text to translate here.
uebersetzung.abschnitt-unbekannt: This section doesn’t exist (the text has {teile}).
uebersetzung.kein-json: The answer is not a JSON object.
uebersetzung.ki-nicht-zugelassen: This folder type is not allowed for AI services – {name} does not receive its content.
organisation.schreibschutz_one: {felder} can only be changed by someone managing the own organisation in administration mode or with a role released for it.
organisation.schreibschutz_other: {felder} can only be changed by someone managing the own organisation in administration mode or with a role released for it.
organisation.keine-eigene: This folder is not an own organisation – please choose an organisation with the attribute “own organisation”.
organisation.notiz.merkmal-aus: no longer marked as own organisation
organisation.mail.text:
Something changed at the own organisation “{name}”: {was} (by {von}).

These details appear on data protection requests and in the deletion concept. Details under Workbench → Settings → Own organisation.
organisation.nichts-bisher: There is no previous controller entry to take over.
organisation.schon-da: There already is an own organisation – please add the previous entry there by hand.
organisation.ohne-basis: This needs a folder type with the attribute “own organisation” – the package Basis from version 1.7.0.
organisation.name-fehlt: Please enter a name for the organisation.
notfallkontakte.name-lang: The name may have at most 60 characters.
notfallkontakte.name-link: The name must not contain “://”, “www.” or “@” – otherwise an email program would turn it into a link.
notfallkontakte.email: Please enter a valid email address.
notfallkontakte.telefon-lang: The phone number may have at most 40 characters.
notfallkontakte.notiz-lang: The note may have at most 120 characters.
notfallkontakte.eigener-name: The info email names you. Enter a name without “://”, “www.” and “@” in your profile.
notfallkontakte.ablage-name: The library name contains “://”, “www.” or “@” and would appear like that in the info email. Change it first.
notfallkontakte.max: At most {max} emergency contacts per library.
notfallkontakte.unbekannt: This emergency contact doesn’t exist (any more).
notfallkontakte.antwort-nur-selbst: Only the person who added the contact can switch on “Replies to my email address”.
notfallkontakte.ohne-versand: Email sending is not set up. The info email goes out as soon as it is.
notfallkontakte.erneut-heute: The info email to this contact has already been sent again today. Try again tomorrow.
notfallkontakte.grenze: {max} emails to emergency contacts have already been sent today. Try again tomorrow.
notfallkontakte.mail-name: A name for the email is missing or looks like a link (your name, the library name or the contact’s name).
notfallkontakte.vertretung: Only someone signed in as themselves can manage emergency contacts – not while acting on someone’s behalf.
